pages.text: A Radiant Trove is a storage container that can contain up to 1024 stacks of a single type of item.

If used as an upgrade, a $(l:arcanearchives:items/devouringcharm)Devouring Charm$(/l) causes items added to the Trove in excess of its maximum capacity are destroyed.$(br2)If used as an upgrade, a $(l:arcanearchives:items/radiantkey)Radiant Key$(/l) locks the type of item in the trove. Once the trove reaches 0 stored items, it will still reserve its storage for the type of item it once held.

Using a $(l:arcanearchives:items/scepterrevelation)Scepter of Revelation$(/l) on a Radiant Trove will return what type of item is stored, its current and maximum capacity, and how many upgrades have been installed.$(br2)Using a $(l:arcanearchives:items/sceptermanipulation)Scepter of Manipulation$(/l) on a Radiant Trove opens a GUI that allows you to see and modify what upgrades are installed.

When monitored with a Redstone Comparator, a Radiant Trove ouptuts a signal based on how full it is.$(br2)Radiant Troves can be crafted on a $(l:arcanearchives:blocks/gemcutterstable)Gem Cutter's Table$(/l).
